title: Choo-choo train, Qwen3-8B in one call (our incomplete harness: no build, it loops)
model: Skippy Core's stock Qwen3-8B (Q4), one call with MineBench's own prompt, the way MineBench runs a model
verdict: Harness fault, found 2026-10-31: this call was not MineBench's procedure. Our copy of its prompt lacked the TOOL MODE section ("you may use ONLY these runtime globals: block, box, line, rng, Math"), and MineBench sends a failure back for up to 8 attempts where this got one. Later runs in this series give a model MineBench's way. What it did here: It started reasonably: a train body, an engine, windows and doors drawn as boxes in stone, glass and dirt. Then it fell into a loop, writing the same two block() lines (two stone blocks at the edge of the grid) over and over for 19 minutes until it reached its 28,000-token limit, so its JSON never closed. Not yet re-run MineBench's way. An 8B model at temperature 0 (the slot's setting for Mentat's routing) is the weakest builder here.
